{{Quote|You hunters are the best that the galaxy's goons and thug lords could send us. Now show us which one of you will join the Great Hunt.|Huntmaster Assistant [[Lek]]|<ref name="Melee" />}}
'''Zeeba''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who competed to participated in the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Zeeba was one of a dozen hunters who competed for the last spot in the Great Hunt,<ref name="Huntmaster" /> and he succeeded in acquiring the three [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] he was assigned in order to advance. He competed in the [[Grand Melee]] against several other hunters, but was slain in the fighting.<ref name="Melee" />

==Equipment==
He wore a [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Clothing/Legends|jacket]] and black pants and used two [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] in combat.<ref name="Huntmaster" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
